# Muammer Kizilaslan — VP IT & Digital, founder of Karriaro

## Summary
Muammer Kizilaslan is Vice President IT & Digital at Hansgrohe SE (Schiltach, Germany) and, since 2026, founder of Karriaro, a self-funded family venture for AI products that he builds alongside his main role. Over 20 years of international IT leadership in three corporations (Hansgrohe, Borusan Mannesmann, BSH Hausgeräte) and three countries (Germany, Turkey, Italy). Born in Stuttgart. Site language: German.

## Current role
- Vice President IT & Digital, Hansgrohe SE, since October 2021
- Global IT and digital strategy; team of about 160 people (about 120 in Germany)
- Transformation strategy with 16 initiatives; global IT service delivery hubs in Turkey and Asia
- SAP S/4HANA migration as a group-wide programme (go-live May 2025); cloud migration strategy; cybersecurity and cyber resilience; digital business models; AI-based automation with measurable productivity gains

## Previous roles
- Chief Digital Officer and board member, Borusan Mannesmann, Istanbul (2019–2021): company-wide digital strategy, new digital business models, ERP and cloud modernisation, supply-chain digitalisation, Industry 4.0 roadmap, agile transformation
- BSH Hausgeräte GmbH (2006–2019), five roles: Head of IT Factories Region T-MEA-CIS, Istanbul (2018–2019, drone-based automated inventory, IDC Innovation Award); IT Manager, Milan (2017–2018); Head of Enterprise Management HR solutions, Munich (2015–2017); Head of Business Intelligence Competency Center, Istanbul (2011–2015, one of the world's largest SAP BI to HANA transformations, 2013); Senior Business Intelligence Engineer, Munich (2006–2010)
- Junior Account Manager, Bechtle AG, Karlsruhe (2005–2006); working student, IBM Deutschland, Düsseldorf (2005)

## Education
- Diplom-Informatiker (FH), business informatics, Fachhochschule Köln (2000–2005)

## Karriaro (family venture, alongside the main role)
- Karriaro-Webdesign (live), Karriaro-Folio (live), Karriaro-Loupe (in development), Karriaro-Mesitara (pilot) — https://karriaro.de/

## Languages
- German (native), Turkish (native), English (fluent), Italian (advanced basics)
